Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zuregex (development version)

  • Bundles PCRE2 10.48, the 8-bit library with its JIT compiler, built without CMake and with every PCRE2 symbol hidden from R’s own copy.
  • zuregex_info() reports the bundled PCRE2 version and whether its JIT compiler works on this machine.
  • re_compile() compiles patterns, with flag letters, a JavaScript dialect, literal patterns and JIT compilation, into re objects that survive saveRDS(). re_info() describes them, and re_escape() quotes metacharacters.
  • Compiled patterns are cached, 128 by default; re_cache_size() and re_cache_clear() manage the cache.
  • Errors are classed conditions inheriting from zuregex_error. An invalid pattern raises zuregex_error_compile, which shows where PCRE2 found the error.
  • re_detect() and re_count() match character vectors, raw vectors and lists of raw vectors, with one pattern for every element or one per element. anchor gives Python’s match() and fullmatch(). Invalid UTF-8 raises zuregex_error_utf, naming the element and byte.
  • re_locate() and re_locate_all() return one-based, inclusive offsets in characters or bytes, so substr() extracts each match. re_locate_all() takes n and overlap, and follows JavaScript’s rule for empty matches with dialect = "js", as re_count() now does.
  • re_extract(), re_extract_all(), re_match() and re_match_all() return matches and capture groups as vectors and data frames built in C. re_match() takes a proto for typed columns, as utils::strcapture() does, and is about 17 times faster than it on 100,000 strings.
  • re_replace() replaces matches with PCRE2’s extended templates ($1, ${name}, ${1:-default}, ${1:+yes:no}, case forcing), literal text, or a function called once with every match. re_expand() expands a template with the first match, and re_split() splits as Python’s re.split() does. Template errors raise zuregex_error_template.
  • re_limits() bounds the work of a match, through limits = on every verb or the zuregex.limits option. An element that hits a limit raises zuregex_error_limit, or gives NA and one warning per call with on_limit = "na".
  • Matching runs on several threads with OpenMP when a call’s subjects pass an internal size threshold, with identical results at any thread count. re_threads() caps the threads; zuregex_info() reports openmp, threads and cache_size.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
